name: Agent402
description: Agent402 model provider: an auto-routed tier at a flat per-call price and explicit frontier models priced per request, paid in USDC over x402 or with a prepaid credits key. Same key reaches 500+ pay-per-call tools.

creditsKey.description: Agent402 prepaid credits key (a402_...). Precedence: this, then AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY, then ~/.openclaw/agent402/credits.key.

walletKey.description: Optional EVM private key for x402 USDC payment (needs @x402/fetch + @x402/evm + viem installed). Precedence: this, then AGENT402_WALLET_KEY, then the wallet `setup` generates at ~/.openclaw/agent402/wallet.key.

pricing.description: metered (default): explicit models pay a per-request quote; flat: every model on its flat tier.

maxPerCallUsd.description: Per-call ceiling in USD for wallet (x402) payments, checked before signing (default 2, the gateway's metered quote cap; 0 or "off" disables). Also AGENT402_MAX_PER_CALL_USD.

creditsKey.label: Credits key
creditsKey.help: Issued at https://agent402.tools/credits; that page says whether new keys are on sale
